bind_address.description: IP address (or hostname) the proxy listens on for client connections.

port.description: TCP port for incoming client connections.

logfile.description: Path to the log file (use /dev/stdout to log to stdout).

daemon.description: Run as a background daemon process.

max_clients.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections allowed.

max_channels.description: Maximum number of channels a single client may auto-join.

default_nick.description: Default nickname used when connecting to IRC servers, if the client doesn't provide one.

default_user.description: Username (ident) used when connecting to IRC servers.

default_realname.description: Real name (GECOS) field used when connecting to IRC servers.

client_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before disconnecting an idle client.

server_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before disconnecting an idle server connection.

reconnect_delay.description: Seconds to wait before retrying a failed server connection.

max_reconnects.description: Maximum number of consecutive failed reconnection attempts before giving up.

ssl.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for all outgoing server connections (unless overridden per server).

ssl_cert.description: Path to client certificate file (PEM format), required if SSL is enabled globally.

ssl_key.description: Path to client private key file (PEM format).

ssl_cafile.description: Path to CA certificate bundle (PEM format), used for server cert verification.

server_password.description: Password used to authenticate to IRC servers (e.g., SASL or legacy pass). Leave blank to skip.

servers.description: List of IRC servers to connect to. Each entry defines a server, its connection settings, and default autojoin channels.

port.description: IRC server port (6697 is typical for SSL).

password.description: Server password (e.g., SASL PLAIN password or legacy server password).

ssl.description: Use SSL/TLS for this server connection.

ssl_verify.description: Verify server certificate using CA file.

ssl_cafile.description: CA bundle path (overrides global ssl_cafile for this server).

autojoin.description: List of channels to auto-join (supports optional channel key: '#channel:key').

allow_clients.description: Optional list of allowed client IPs/nets with optional passwords (whitelist). If empty, all clients are allowed.

host.description: Allowed client host/IP or CIDR subnet (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24').

password.description: Client auth password (if omitted, no password required).

admin_password.description: Shared password for administrative commands sent via client (e.g., /DIRCPROXY). Leave blank to disable.

log_privates.description: Log private messages (if disabled, only server commands are logged).
